name: Pestilent Corrompu
description: Colonisateur fondant de nouvelles bases fongiques parasitant les ressources locales pour nourrir la croissance du Fléau.

subject.archetype: Pestilent Corrompu — Fléau Spore Rare class spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Living fungal armor growing and pulsating in rhythm with host's heartbeat, toxic spore clouds emanating perpetually from pores across entire surface creating visible green haze, thick mycelial reinforcement visible beneath surface like living root systems, organic matter and fungal growths dripping from every edge with new growth visibly sprouting during combat with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Living spore projection organ on forearm launching concentrated toxic bursts at high velocity like organic projectile weapons, toxic secretion glands in fingertips pulsating and releasing corrosive droplets that sizzle on contact, thick mycelial whip extending from back acting as ranged organic weapon that lashes out to grapple targets The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting self_on_flip, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Forward operative establishing hostile territory position with tools planting markers and building temporary structures. Body flipping violently between states as captured with both hands slamming into ground sending focused targeted shockwave through all adjacent positions, final devastating act of dying warrior
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Toxic Green
palette_names.role: primary_accent — spore clouds and acid splash effects

palette_names.name: Decay Brown
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — rotting surfaces and decomposing matter

palette_names.name: Corrosive Yellow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — acid burns and infection glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by fungal infestation, thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze, massive mycelial networks pulsating and growing visibly across all surfaces converting terrain into living organism, both ally and enemy positions attacked by spreading infection, massive pulsating sacs bursting and releasing contamination, ground itself alive and hostile with fungal tendrils bursting through without warning
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Explosive shockwave radiating outward in perfect circle with incredible force, visible ring of energy passing through all adjacent positions simultaneously with cascading chain reaction, Ground erupting with visible shockwave, debris lifted and thrown outward by force, visible damage spreading to all adjacent tiles as energy wave passes through, Massive spore explosion blasting toxic green clouds outward at high speed, thick mycelial tendrils bursting through walls and floors like organic spears, acidic fluid dripping from fungal growths creating sizzling smoke plumes, infection spreading visibly across surfaces like fast-forward timelapse consuming everything, pulsating organic sacs bursting on impact releasing concentrated contamination clouds
